name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme covering yield loss due to pests and disease. Claim must be filed within 72 hours of noticing damage.
how_to_apply: Contact your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or bank branch, or apply online at pmfby.gov.in

name: Kisan Call Centre / SMS Advisory
description: Free agronomic advisory service; can validate an on-device diagnosis with a human expert.
how_to_apply: Call 1800-180-1551 (toll-free) or register for SMS advisories via your local KVK.

name: State Input Subsidy for Plant Protection Chemicals
description: Partial subsidy on approved fungicides/pesticides purchased through registered dealers.
how_to_apply: Available through the state Department of Agriculture portal; requires land record (7/12 extract or equivalent).
